page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage must be attached externally and workloads requiring hardware acceleration are not supported. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput network operations. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention from other tenants.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated resources, the ecs.g8ae.16xlarge is suited for enterprise applications, web serving, mid-sized databases, and general-purpose workloads that require stable CPU performance and moderate memory capacity.
